name: Illinois

response.rule_text: Public body must comply with or deny a written request within five business days of receipt, extendable by up to five business days for listed reasons, 5 ILCS 140/3(d), (e).

fees.labor_rule: Public body may not charge for search, review or personnel costs of reproducing records, 5 ILCS 140/6.
fees.copy_rule: First 50 pages of black-and-white letter/legal copies free; after that not over 15 cents per page (actual cost for other media), 5 ILCS 140/6(b).
fees.late_penalty: Public body that fails to respond on time may not charge fees for copies or treat the request as unduly burdensome (5 ILCS 140/3(d)); RCFP text on this partly truncated.

residency.rule_text: Records available to 'any person' (individuals, corporations, associations), 5 ILCS 140/3(a), 2(b).

appeal.body: Public Access Counselor (Office of the Attorney General) or circuit court
appeal.rule_text: A denied requester may file a request for review with the Public Access Counselor in the AG's office (5 ILCS 140/9.5(a)), who may issue a binding or advisory opinion or mediate, or sue directly in circuit court. Request is deemed denied if no response in 5 business days.

notes: PAC review deadline not found in fetched RCFP text (null). PAC review not available against the General Assembly and its committees. 'Late penalty' clause in fees is from the response-timing text; verify before citing. Governor not extracted.
